title: Personal Brand Launch Scripts and CTAs
source_note: Note: Make your CTA as CLEAR as possible… Literally tell them EXACTLY what you want them to do (book a call, follow you, click the link in bio, etc)

fields.name: Hook
fields.instruction: Let them know you are about to let them in on some valuable information - use hook from education section of template

fields.name: Hack/Tip
fields.instruction: In a short sentence let them know what it is you are about to teach them (only if hook did not mention it)

fields.name: How - To
fields.instruction: Show viewer exactly how to do hack/tip with practical steps they can do

fields.name: CTA
fields.instruction: Let them know you post valuable stuff like this everyday and they should definitely follow ;) - use CTA from follow section of template

fields.name: Hook
fields.instruction: Use hook from myth section of template

fields.name: Myth
fields.instruction: State the myth (skip this if you state the myth in your hook)

fields.name: Debunk
fields.instruction: Explain why this myth is wrong

fields.name: Solution
fields.instruction: Introduce what they should do instead to achieve their dream result

fields.name: Promote
fields.instruction: Subtly hit that your product/service helps people achieve their dream result

fields.name: CTA
fields.instruction: Let them know where they can find more information about your product or service - use CTA from sales section of template

fields.name: Viral Video Hook
fields.instruction: Add in a 5-7 second viral Tiktok or Instagram Reel that talks about something relating to your niche

fields.name: Share Your Expert Opinion
fields.instruction: Is it true or complete BS? If it’s true explain why, if it’s BS explain what you should do instead

fields.name: CTA
fields.instruction: Remind them you are an expert in your field and they should follow - use hook from follow section of template

fields.name: Hook
fields.instruction: Use hook from step-by-step system section of template

fields.name: Introduce
fields.instruction: State the name of the framework you are about to teach them if applicable or state you are about to tell them the steps - Ex. Here are the X steps you need to take

fields.name: Step #1
fields.instruction: State step and explain the step in 1-2 brief sentences

fields.name: Step #2
fields.instruction: State step and explain the step in 1-2 brief sentences

fields.name: Step #3
fields.instruction: State step and explain the step in 1-2 brief sentences

fields.name: Promote (optional)
fields.instruction: Let them know you help people do exactly this (in the CTA you would go and let them know where they can find more information about your product and service)

fields.name: CTA
fields.instruction: Use CTA from sales, engagement, or follow section of template

fields.name: Hook
fields.instruction: Use hook from common mistake section of template

fields.name: Common Mistake
fields.instruction: Introduce common mistake (if you did not in the hook)

fields.name: Debrief
fields.instruction: Explain why this is a mistake

fields.name: Solution
fields.instruction: Let them know what they can do instead to achieve their dream result

fields.name: Promote (optional)
fields.instruction: Let them know you help (ideal customer) achieve (dream result) (in the CTA you would go and let them know where they can find more information about your product and service)

fields.name: CTA
fields.instruction: Use CTA from sales, engagement, or follow section of template

fields.name: Hook
fields.instruction: Use hook from authority section of template

fields.name: Social Proof
fields.instruction: Show real results you got or got a client

fields.name: How-To
fields.instruction: Explain tip/hack or step by step breakdown the viewer can do to achieve dream result

fields.name: CTA
fields.instruction: Use CTA from sales section of template

fields.name: Hook
fields.instruction: State a common pain point of your ideal customer/client

fields.name: Solution
fields.instruction: Let them know there is light at the end of the tunnel aka a solution and they don’t have to feel like that if they don’t want to

fields.name: Value
fields.instruction: Give them an actionable step by step solution to help solve said problem

fields.name: Promote
fields.instruction: Subtly let them know your product/service helps people do exactly this to achieve dream result

fields.name: CTA
fields.instruction: Use CTA from sales section of template
